mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHECKOUT ( CHECKOUT_NO, MEMBER_NO, CREATED_AT, PRODUCT_AMOUNT, INSTANT_DISCOUNT, COUPON_DISCOUNT, CASH_USED, DELIVERY_FEE, TOTAL_PRICE ) VALUES ( #{checkoutNo}, #{memberNo}, SYSDATE, #{productAmount}, #{instantDiscount}, #{couponDiscount}, #{cashUsed}, #{deliveryFee}, #{totalPrice} )

INSERT INTO CHECKOUT_ITEM ( CHECKOUT_ITEM_NO, CHECKOUT_NO, PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, ORDER_QTY, PRICE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CHECKOUT_ITEM_NO.NEXTVAL, #{checkoutNo}, #{productNo}, #{optionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice} )
